quote: The Wikipedia bullet asks the general question (posed by Grätzer–Schmidt in 1963 and shown by Pálfy–Pudlák in 1980 to be equivalent to a question about subgroup-lattice intervals in finite groups): is EVERY finite lattice a congruence lattice of a finite algebra?
note: The problem asks whether every finite lattice is isomorphic to the congruence lattice of some finite algebra. This general form was posed by Grätzer and Schmidt in 1963.
